Endorse *
  * I endorse Andy Thomson for Boca Raton Mayor!


Submit![Loading](https://www.andythomson.com/wp-content/plugins/wpforms/assets/images/submit-spin.svg)
### Priorities for Boca Raton
A Better Quality of Life for Every Resident.
![](https://www.andythomson.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/priority-icon-1.png)
### Stop the Government Campus Redevelopment
Residents are clearly opposed to giving away public land to private developers. I hear you and agree.
![](https://www.andythomson.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/priority-icon-2.png)
### Addressing Cost of Living
Costs are rising. I am committed to finding ways to address housing affordability and general price increases.
![](https://www.andythomson.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/priority-icon-3.png)
### Responsible Growth
Protecting the unique character of our neighborhoods and ensuring new development serves residents — not just developers.
![](https://www.andythomson.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/priority-icon-4.png)
### Traffic & Mobility
Implementing smart, technology-driven solutions to reduce congestion and get you home faster.
![](https://www.andythomson.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/priority-icon-5.png)
### Quality of Life
Investing in public safety, world-class parks, clean streets, and amenities that make Boca such a great place to live.
### ANDY THOMSON’S RECORD OF PROTECTING YOUR WALLET
![](https://www.andythomson.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/wave-img.jpg)
![](https://www.andythomson.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/andy-thomson-quote-img.png)
“As your Mayor, I promise to treat every tax dollar with respect. I will never support wasteful spending projects that burden our families. My priority is a safe, beautiful, and affordable Boca Raton.”
–
![](https://www.andythomson.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/andy-signature.png)
### Cut the Tax Rate 6 Times
Andy didn’t just talk about it — he did it. He voted to cut the millage rate six times, saving taxpayers millions while maintaining high service standards.
### Kept Utility Costs Low
Under Andy’s leadership, Boca Raton has maintained some of the lowest water and sewer rates in the region. He fights to keep your monthly bills manageable.
### Voted Against the Giveaway of Public Land
When a plan was proposed to give away public land worth hundreds of millions of dollars to private developers, Andy stood firm. He has repeatedly voted to stop the giveaway and ensure that residents have a chance to vote on it.
### Fought for Workforce Housing
Andy has a long record of supporting workforce housing to help make living in Boca Raton a possibility for our teachers, nurses, and first responders.
### ANDY THOMSON
A Proven Record. On the Record.
Andy Thomson is the ONLY councilmember who stood up to the Government Campus Redevelopment plan — every step of the way.
### Not just words. Public Votes. On the record.
  * Andy voted **against the interim agreement** with the developer.
  * Andy voted **against the interim development plan.**
  * Andy voted **against allowing the developer to donate** to candidates for Boca Raton City Council & Mayor.
  * Andy voted to ensure **residents — YOU — get the final say** at the ballot box.


### Don’t take anyone’s word for it. Watch the votes yourself:
March 18, 2025: Voted NO on the interim agreement with the developer.
June 10, 2025: Voted NO on the interim master plan.
September 9, 2025: Led the effort to require that voters get a say on the Government Campus project.
